text:
Priya Nair: quick heads-up — ran the nightly quantization smoke for MistralX-34B (fp16 cast path) and seeing a weird drift in long-context completion scores vs fp32 baseline. not sure if it's rotary scaling or a subtle casting order bug.

Mateo Garcia: can you paste the eval diffs? is this across seeds or one run?

Priya Nair: one run so far but reproducible locally. short summary: up to 1024 steps perf matches, after ~1500 tokens ppl & exact-match drop and attention scores look off. attached snippet from the failing trace: 
```
[2026-03-19T22:12:11Z] step=1600 model=mistralx-34b quant=fp16_cast kernel=attn_kv
log: mean_attn_diag_shift=0.0038 expected<0.0004, mean_kv_scale=1.12 expected~1.0
```

Alice Kim: throwing this to the team — could be ordering of cast->rotary->kvcache ops. we had a PR earlier that moved casts to just-in-time before matmul. Jun, any recent runtime changes?

Jun Park: I landed the JIT-cast change last week but added a small optimization for headwise rotary scale normalization on gemma/mistral variants. i can revert locally to compare.

Priya Nair: thanks. i also ran a quick cross-model check: Llama3 fp16_cast shows no drift, but GemmaX with same path shows a smaller but present effect. points to a conditional codepath in rotary/headwise normalization.

Mateo Garcia: if it's conditional, maybe different codepaths trigger based on seq_len/blocking. can you dump the sequence of ops and dtypes for a problematic batch? e.g., a short trace of op,dtype,shape.

Priya Nair: pasted a minimal trace (cropped): 
```
op: rotary_mul dtype=float16 shape=(8,32,1024,64)
op: cast_to_fp16_from_bf16 dtype=bf16->float16
op: kv_cache_write dtype=float16 shape=(8,32,2048,64)
op: matmul_qk dtype=float32 (cast up)
```
Jun Park: ah — matmul_qk cast up to float32 after rotary_mul in that trace. that ordering could amplify small rotary quantization errors when combined with headwise scaling. i'll try adjusting to perform rotary in float32 then cast down for kv write.

quant-bot: run queued: quant-smoke/mistralx-34b/fp16-cast/2026-03-20T02:00:00Z

infra-bot: ci job retriggered by Jun Park — job id ci-90421

Priya Nair: one more note — eval set shows hallucination spikes on QA benchmarks (answer drift) rather than token-level probs only. suggests accumulation error in attention weights.

Mateo Garcia: OK. Jun, if reverting the JIT ordering fixes it, we should add a targeted unit test that compares attention matrices (L2 dist) between fp32 baseline and fp16_cast for long contexts (>1600). make it part of nightly.

Jun Park: will do. allocating time now, will post CI diffs and a short patch if needed.

Alice Kim: thanks everyone. Priya — once we have CI results, file a short bug/triage note with the eval diffs and mark as P1 for model-onboarding (since this blocks MistralX fp16 rollout). :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: noted — will upload diffs and a minimal repro script to the onboarding ticket. thanks!
